scenes.title: Brenda Milner re-introducing herself to Henry across the Montreal testing table minutes after stepping out
scenes.era: 1955-1957, clinical neuropsychology testing room in Hartford / Montreal

layout.description: Sunlit mid-1950s wood-paneled clinical testing room with a neat oak desk, a well-worn Life magazine whose crossword puzzle has already been penciled in, and a testing stopwatch.

positions.who: Henry Molaison (29-year-old mannequin in 1950s collared plaid shirt and cardigan)
positions.where: seated politely across the oak desk extending his right hand with a warm first-time greeting posture

positions.who: Brenda Milner (mannequin in 1950s tailored blazer and white blouse holding clipboard)
positions.where: stepping back through the wooden door she exited just five minutes earlier, shaking Henry's hand gently

props.name: three-digit rehearsal card ('584')
props.period_detail: white index card printed with the digits 584 resting face-down beside a stopwatch
props.physical_behavior: forgotten completely the moment a brief knock interrupted Henry's rehearsal

props.name: re-read 1950s picture magazine
props.period_detail: illustrated magazine on the corner of the desk with margins showing Henry's own handwriting from twenty minutes ago
props.physical_behavior: picked up by Henry as if opening a brand-new issue

props.name: 28-bolt stylus stepping-stone board
props.period_detail: wooden board studded with metal bolt heads wired to an error buzzer
props.physical_behavior: sits on the side table after 215 unremembered trials

actions.verb_sequence: steps back into the testing room after a five-minute pause -> extends her hand across the oak desk
rises politely to shake her hand as a complete stranger -> glances at the face-down '584' card with zero recognition

reactions.reaction: tilts his head with quiet courtesy when asked what test they were doing three minutes ago
records the clean split between intact 118-IQ conversation and vanished episodic recall

scenes.wardrobe: Henry: mid-1950s buttoned collared shirt, wool cardigan, pressed trousers. Brenda Milner: 1950s tailored dark wool jacket over crisp white blouse and skirt.
scenes.lighting: Warm, high-key 1950s window daylight across oak furniture and white test cards.
scenes.recognition_hook: Five minutes after finishing a 15-minute number test together, Henry rises politely to shake Brenda Milner's hand as if meeting her for the very first time.

key_visual.description: a 1950s male patient at an oak clinical desk shaking hands with a returning female neuropsychologist as a total stranger beside a face-down 584 index card and magazine

scenes.title: Fifteen-minute unbroken rehearsal of 584 shattered by one distraction

layout.description: Close view of the oak testing desk with a mechanical stopwatch sweeping past 15 minutes while Henry whispers quietly.

positions.where: leaning forward tapping three fingers softly in an unbroken rehearsal loop
introducing a brief side question to shift his attention

props.name: mechanical stopwatch and 584 card
props.physical_behavior: clicks stopped right before Milner asks a distracting question

actions.verb_sequence: places a picture card down to divert Henry's attention for thirty seconds -> asks again for the three-digit number

reactions.reaction: opens both palms empty — neither the number 584 nor the test itself remains

scenes.recognition_hook: Fifteen minutes of working-memory focus evaporates in thirty seconds once attention shifts.

scenes.title: Scoville & Milner's 10-patient anatomical map comparison

layout.description: Bright office lightbox displaying clean line diagrams comparing unilateral versus bilateral medial temporal resections across 10 surgical cases.

positions.where: tracing the bilateral medial temporal boundary on an anatomical chart with a fountain pen

props.name: 1957 Brain diagram plates
props.period_detail: clean black-and-white anatomical cross-sections comparing Case H.M. with unilateral cases
props.physical_behavior: highlights bilateral hippocampal involvement only in severe amnesia

actions.verb_sequence: circles the bilateral hippocampal zone and checks off the severe-amnesia column

reactions.reaction: pauses as the anatomical localization of conscious memory becomes unmistakable

scenes.recognition_hook: Comparing ten surgical cases proved only bilateral hippocampal loss erased new conscious memories.

scenes.title: Protecting modern working memory from interruption

layout.description: Sunlit wooden desk where a student mannequin places a smartphone face-down out of reach while writing key notes by hand.

positions.where: seated at a clean desk writing uninterrupted summary notes

props.name: handwritten notebook and silenced phone
props.period_detail: lined notebook beside a silenced phone placed across the desk

actions.verb_sequence: sets phone aside -> finishes writing the full concept before switching tasks

reactions.reaction: closes the notebook with calm retention

scenes.recognition_hook: Giving your hippocampus thirty uninterrupted seconds lets working memory cross into lasting storage.
